items.title: First Boer War
items.why: Vital article, level 5. The 1880 to 1881 war between Britain and the Transvaal Boers. Its own article names it part of Q1676845, the Boer Wars series, but that record was merged into second-boer-war in M44b and the merge note says the held record covers only the second war. No living record stands for the series, so this stays unfiled.
